summary: 10M LIGHT SOLUTIONS AS (org. no. 833 431 862) is a private limited company (AS) based in Bergen, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2024-05-10. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 74.110 (Industri-, produkt- og motedesignvirksomhet). In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 305 007 and net income was NOK 18 759. CEO: Erlend Refsdal Thiem; board chair: Erlend Refsdal Thiem.
